messages:
Eva: Quick pulse on MarinerX-7B onboarding for the catalog. Licensing flagged two items and perf wants a canary window. TL;DR — who owns final artifact + model card, and canary dates?

Ravi: I'll own the runtime/profile side. Built a q4_8 checkpoint yesterday. Need model shape confirmation (tensor dims) and a green light for staging deploy. Ping @Sam for latency numbers at ~1k gen tokens.

Sam: ran a short run on staging hardware (p3dn). Quick perf snapshot:
```
Model: MarinerX-7B (q4_8)
HW: p3dn.24xlarge
Prompt len: 32
Gen len: 256
P50 latency: 420ms
P95 latency: 920ms
Tokens/sec (steady): 85
```
Not tuned for memory yet — P95 drops ~15% after we tweak kv-cache policy. :eyes:

Nicole: Legal notes: license is OSS-with-attribution variant. Need a model card with provenance + training data high-level description, and confirmation there are no third-party restricted weights. I can finish review by EOD Wed if we get artifact + model card link.

jmiller: I can draft the model card. Would like a small eval set + representative prompts (esp safety/qa prompts). Can someone drop the eval CSV or S3 link here?

infra-bot: Deploy job 8792 queued by Ravi -> staging cluster a6. Starting container pull...

Ravi: Staging canary planned Tue 09:00 PT. Plan: 10k synthetic qps run that mirrors production prompt distribution. Will auto-roll only if perf + legal thumbs up.

Sam: perf thumbs up contingent on adding microbench with batch=512 and a memory sweep. I'll add that job to the canary pipeline today.

Nicole: once we have model card + artifact checksum and provenance notes, legal stands by for canary signoff. :thumbsup:

Eva: Owners recap: Ravi (runtime), jmiller (model card), Sam (perf), Nicole (legal). Action items: Ravi attach artifact + checksum, jmiller attach draft card, Sam add microbench to canary, Nicole confirm license on artifact. Also add tracing id & cost tags to canary runs.

Sam: noted — will add tracing id header: X-Trace-Model: marinerx-7b.v1 and route param model_version=v1 in canary config.

Ravi: Artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-models/marinerx/7b/q4_8/checkpoint.tar.gz. sha256: 3a7f...b2de. Added shape metadata in manifest.json.

jmiller: drafted model card uploaded: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/marinerx/7b/model_card.md — still needs the eval CSV.

Eva: Thanks. Nicole, Ravi — can we aim to start the canary Tue 09:00 PT if legal clears by Mon EOD?

Nicole: yes, aiming for Mon EOD. I'll post final signoff message here when complete.

legal-bot: Automated note: License review in progress for marinerx-7b. Reviewer: Nicole. SLA target: 48 hours.

infra-bot: Staging deploy job 8792 started — pulling image, mounting volumes, allocating GPUs. Will post logs as job progresses.

Eva: Great — closing loop for now. I'll update catalog ticket #4567 with owners & canary plan. Please @reply if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
